The ESM Metagenomic Atlas provides a comprehensive database of over 700 million protein structures and embeddings predicted using ESMFold from metagenomic data\. This resource allows users to access pre\-computed structural information and language model representations for a vast collection of proteins\. The atlas facilitates various applications, including structural analysis, functional inference, and integration with other bioinformatics tools like Foldseek\.

 The atlas organizes its data into different versions, with [README\.md?plain=1 L12](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L12) based on the MGnify [README\.md?plain=1 L7](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L7) database and [README\.md?plain=1 L235](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L235), and [README\.md?plain=1 L13](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L13) utilizing the MGnify [README\.md?plain=1 L8](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L8) database and [README\.md?plain=1 L211](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L211)\. These versions are documented in [`scripts/atlas/README.md`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md)\.

 For each version, the atlas offers several data types for bulk download:

 - **Predicted PDB Structures**: These are available as gzipped tarball archives\. The manifest files, such as [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/tarballs.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/tarballs.txt) and [`scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/tarballs.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/tarballs.txt), provide URLs for these archives\. The structures are organized into bins based on predicted TM\-score \([fold\.py L194](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/fold.py#L194)\) and pLDDT scores, allowing users to filter by quality\.
- **Foldseek Databases**: Components for Foldseek databases, essential for structural similarity searches, are also provided\. URLs can be found in files like [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/foldseekdb.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/foldseekdb.txt) and [`scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/foldseekdb.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/foldseekdb.txt)\.
- **ESM2 Language Model Embeddings**: Pre\-computed ESM2 representations are available, particularly for [README\.md?plain=1 L13](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L13), in [esm2\_embeddings\.txt L1](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings.txt#L1) archives\. The URLs for these embeddings are listed in [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings.txt) and [`scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/esm2_embeddings.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/esm2_embeddings.txt)\.

 A central [README\.md?plain=1 L22](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L22) or [README\.md?plain=1 L22](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L22) file acts as an entry point to the database, containing detailed information for each record, such as [ngram\.py L35](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/examples/lm-design/utils/ngram.py#L35), [folding\_callbacks\.py L24](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/examples/protein-programming-language/language/folding_callbacks.py#L24), [folding\_callbacks\.py L25](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/examples/protein-programming-language/language/folding_callbacks.py#L25), [data\.py L44](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/esm/data.py#L44), and [README\.md?plain=1 L31](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L31)\. This metadata allows users to filter and select specific structures based on quality metrics, which is particularly useful for identifying high\-confidence subsets\. For example, a high\-quality clustered subset for [README\.md?plain=1 L12](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L12) is available in [`scripts/atlas/v0/highquality_clust30`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/highquality_clust30)\.

 The [`scripts/atlas`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas) directory provides scripts and resources to interact with this atlas\. For efficient downloads, tools like [README\.md?plain=1 L39](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L39) or [README\.md?plain=1 L39](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L39) are recommended\. An example of a download script, [`scripts/download_weights.sh`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/download_weights.sh), demonstrates how to retrieve model weights\. For details on utilizing these resources, refer to [Atlas Versions and Data Organization](https://codewiki.google/github.com/facebookresearch/esm#esm-metagenomic-atlas-atlas-versions-and-data-organization), [Accessing and Downloading Atlas Data](https://codewiki.google/github.com/facebookresearch/esm#esm-metagenomic-atlas-accessing-and-downloading-atlas-data), and [Utilizing Atlas Metadata and High\-Confidence Subsets](https://codewiki.google/github.com/facebookresearch/esm#esm-metagenomic-atlas-utilizing-atlas-metadata-and-high-confidence-subsets)\.### Atlas Versions and Data Organization

| Atlas Version | Release Date | MGnify DB Version | ESMFold Model |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| v0 | Nov 1st 2022 | 2022\_05 | esmfold\_v0\(\) |
| v2023\_02 | Mar 17th 2023 | 2023\_02 | esmfold\_v1\(\) |

The ESM Metagenomic Atlas provides a large collection of protein structures and embeddings derived from metagenomic data\. It is organized into distinct versions, each built upon specific underlying data and prediction models\.

 The initial release, [README\.md?plain=1 L12](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L12), was introduced on November 1st, 2022\. This version utilized the [README\.md?plain=1 L7](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L7) release of the MGnify protein database and employed [README\.md?plain=1 L235](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L235) for structure prediction\. The second major release, [README\.md?plain=1 L13](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L13), followed on March 17th, 2023\. This version was based on the more recent [README\.md?plain=1 L8](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L8) MGnify database and used [README\.md?plain=1 L211](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L211) for its predictions\. These versions are housed in directories like [`scripts/atlas/v0`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0) and [`scripts/atlas/v2023_02`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v2023_02) respectively\.

 A key organizational principle of the Atlas is the categorization of predicted structures and embeddings by quality metrics: predicted TM\-score \([fold\.py L194](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/fold.py#L194)\) and predicted Local Distance Difference Test \([README\.md?plain=1 L229](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L229)\)\. These scores are used to define bins, allowing users to filter and access specific subsets of the data based on desired confidence levels\. For instance, structures can be filtered for "high confidence" subsets \(e\.g\., [README\.md?plain=1 L89](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L89) and [README\.md?plain=1 L89](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L89)\)\.

 The structure prediction data, Foldseek databases, and ESM2 language model embeddings are further organized into subdirectories within each version, such as [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/tarballs`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/tarballs), [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/foldseekdb`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/foldseekdb), and [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings)\. Within these directories, individual manifest files \(e\.g\., [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/bins.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/bins.txt), [`scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/bins.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/bins.txt)\) define the specific [fold\.py L194](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/fold.py#L194) and [README\.md?plain=1 L229](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L229) ranges for each bin\. For a comprehensive overview of how to access and download these datasets, refer to [Accessing and Downloading Atlas Data](https://codewiki.google/github.com/facebookresearch/esm#esm-metagenomic-atlas-accessing-and-downloading-atlas-data)\.

 Additionally, specific high\-quality, clustered subsets are available, such as the [README\.md?plain=1 L68](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L68) subset within [README\.md?plain=1 L12](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L12), located at [`scripts/atlas/v0/highquality_clust30`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/highquality_clust30)\. This subset is generated by applying further filtering and clustering to ensure high structural quality and reduced redundancy\. More details on leveraging these subsets and filtering metadata can be found in [Utilizing Atlas Metadata and High\-Confidence Subsets](https://codewiki.google/github.com/facebookresearch/esm#esm-metagenomic-atlas-utilizing-atlas-metadata-and-high-confidence-subsets)\.### Accessing and Downloading Atlas Data

| Version | Data Type | Example Manifest Path |
| --- | --- | --- |
| v0 | Predicted Structures | v0/full/tarballs/tm\_\.60\_\.70\_plddt\_\.80\_\.90\.txt  v0/full/tarballs/backfill\_v0\_tm\_\.40\_\.50\_plddt\_\.40\_\.50\.txt |
| v0 | Foldseek DBs | v0/full/foldseekdb/tm\_\.60\_\.70\_plddt\_\.80\_\.90\.txt  v0/full/foldseekdb/backfill\_v0\_tm\_\.40\_\.50\_plddt\_\.40\_\.50\.txt |
| v0 | ESM2 Embeddings | v0/full/esm2\_embeddings/tm\_\.40\_\.50\_plddt\_\.40\_\.50\.txt |
| v0 | High Confidence MGnify30 Structures | v0/highquality\_clust30/tarballs\.txt |
| v0 | High Confidence MGnify30 Foldseek DB | v0/highquality\_clust30/foldseekdb\.txt |
| v2023\_02 | Predicted Structures | v2023\_02/full/tarballs/tm\_\.60\_\.70\_plddt\_\.80\_\.90\.txt |
| v2023\_02 | Foldseek DBs | v2023\_02/full/foldseekdb/tm\_\.60\_\.70\_plddt\_\.80\_\.90\_00\.DB |
| v2023\_02 | ESM2 Embeddings | v2023\_02/full/esm2\_embeddings/tm\_\.40\_\.50\_plddt\_\.40\_\.50\.txt |

The ESM Metagenomic Atlas provides a comprehensive collection of pre\-computed protein structures, Foldseek databases, and ESM2 language model embeddings\. These resources are organized into versions, primarily [README\.md?plain=1 L12](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L12) and [README\.md?plain=1 L13](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L13), corresponding to different releases of the MGnify database and ESMFold models, as detailed in [Atlas Versions and Data Organization](https://codewiki.google/github.com/facebookresearch/esm#esm-metagenomic-atlas-atlas-versions-and-data-organization)\.

 Access to the Atlas data is facilitated through manifest files, which are plain text documents containing URLs for bulk downloading\. For predicted protein structures, [data\.py L402](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/esm/data.py#L402) files within directories such as [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/tarballs`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/tarballs) and [`scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/tarballs`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/tarballs) provide direct links to gzipped tarball archives\. Similarly, Foldseek database components can be downloaded using manifest files found in [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/foldseekdb`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/foldseekdb) and [`scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/foldseekdb`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/foldseekdb)\. ESM2 language model embeddings are accessible via manifests in [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings) and [`scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/esm2_embeddings`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v2023_02/full/esm2_embeddings)\.

 The Atlas organizes data by predicted TM\-score and pLDDT bins, allowing users to select specific subsets based on quality criteria\. For example, files like [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings/tm_.40_.50_plddt_.40_.50.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings/tm_.40_.50_plddt_.40_.50.txt) indicate that the linked data corresponds to proteins with TM\-scores between 0\.40 and 0\.50, and pLDDT scores also within that range\. Some manifests, such as [`scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings/backfill_v0_tm_.40_.50_plddt_.40_.50.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/full/esm2_embeddings/backfill_v0_tm_.40_.50_plddt_.40_.50.txt), refer to "backfill" data, indicating supplementary or updated datasets\.

 For efficient bulk downloads, tools like [README\.md?plain=1 L39](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L39) or [README\.md?plain=1 L39](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L39) are recommended\. An example command for [README\.md?plain=1 L39](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L39) is provided in [`scripts/atlas/README.md`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md)\. These tools can process the [data\.py L402](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/esm/data.py#L402) manifest files to retrieve the desired data archives programmatically\. This approach ensures that users can obtain specific segments of the vast metagenomic protein structure data based on their research needs without manually navigating individual files\.### Utilizing Atlas Metadata and High\-Confidence Subsets

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| id | MGnify ID for the protein\. |
| ptm | Predicted TM score\. |
| plddt | Predicted average lDDT score\. |
| num\_conf | Number of residues with pLDDT \> 0\.7\. |
| len | Total number of residues in the protein\. |
| is\_fragment | Indicates if the protein sequence is identified as a fragment in the MGnify90 sequence database\. |
| sequenceChecksum | CRC64 hash of the sequence, useful for efficient lookups\. |
| esmfold\_version | Version of ESMFold used for prediction \(e\.g\., esmfold\_v0, esmfold\_v1\)\. |
| atlas\_version | Atlas version where the structure first appeared\. Some v0 predictions are also in v2023\_02\. |
| sequence\_dbs | Metagenomic source databases containing this structure \(e\.g\., MGnify90\_2022\_05, MGnify90\_2022\_05,MGnify90\_2023\_02\)\. Records with plddt\.isna\(\) were not folded \(proteins \> 1280 residues\)\. |

The ESM Metagenomic Atlas provides [README\.md?plain=1 L22](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L22) or [README\.md?plain=1 L22](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L22) files as a primary entry point to efficiently filter and select specific protein structures\. These metadata files contain extensive information for over 700 million records, including unique identifiers, [fold\.py L194](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/fold.py#L194) \(predicted TM score\), [README\.md?plain=1 L229](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/README.md?plain=1#L229) \(predicted average lddt\), the number of confident residues, sequence length, and information about whether a sequence is a fragment\. Users can load these files, for example using [README\.md?plain=1 L23](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L23), to programmatically query and filter the vast dataset based on desired quality metrics\. For instance, entries representing proteins longer than 1280 residues, which were not folded, can be excluded by filtering for records where [folding\_callbacks\.py L25](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/examples/protein-programming-language/language/folding_callbacks.py#L25) is not null\.

 Beyond general filtering, the Atlas also provides access to specialized high\-confidence subsets for focused research\. A notable example is the high\-confidence MGnify30 structures, which represent a curated collection derived by clustering MGnify90 data at 30% sequence similarity, and then applying strict filters for [README\.md?plain=1 L89](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L89) and [README\.md?plain=1 L89](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L89)\. From each cluster, the best structure is selected based on the product of [fold\.py L193](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/fold.py#L193)\. The URLs for downloading these high\-quality, clustered datasets are provided in manifests such as [`scripts/atlas/v0/highquality_clust30/tarballs.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/highquality_clust30/tarballs.txt) and [`scripts/atlas/v0/highquality_clust30/foldseekdb.txt`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/v0/highquality_clust30/foldseekdb.txt)\. These filtered subsets allow researchers to work with highly reliable structural predictions, optimizing downstream analysis and model training\. The corresponding protein sequences for these high\-confidence structures are available in [README\.md?plain=1 L72](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm/blob/2b369911bb5b4b0dda914521b9475cad1656b2ac/scripts/atlas/README.md?plain=1#L72)\. For details on how these metadata files and high\-confidence subsets relate to the broader Atlas structure and data organization, refer to [Atlas Versions and Data Organization](https://codewiki.google/github.com/facebookresearch/esm#esm-metagenomic-atlas-atlas-versions-and-data-organization)\.
